description: This is a JUnit test class for the BookUtils utility class in the book project. It tests methods that combine book titles with series information, verifying behavior when books are not in a series, when the position is zero, and when the position is positive.

classes.name: BookUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for BookUtils, testing the combination of book titles and series information.

methods.name: BookUtilsTest(PredefinedShelfService)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Book object with a predefined shelf obtained via dependency injection.

methods.name: notShowSeriesPositionIfBookIsNotInSeries
methods.description: Test that verifies the title remains unchanged if the book's series position is null.

methods.name: returnTitleWhenSeriesPositionIsZero
methods.description: Test that verifies the title remains unchanged if the book's series position is zero.

methods.name: showSeriesPositionCorrectly
methods.description: Test that verifies the title correctly appends the series position when it is a positive number.
